name: Stranded
desc:
🏝️ Welcome to Stranded! 🏝️ 
 
💎 Mine Various Unique Ores
⚔️ Battle Players to the Death
🔨 Construct a Base 
🧨 Raid Opposing Player's Bases
🏞️ Explore a Multitude of Biomes and the many secrets they hold
🦀 Encounter Different Wild Animals
🗡️ Fight tough Enemies and defeat powerful Bosses
🛠️ Craft Armor, Weapons, Tools & more to become the most powerful player to ever live
📜Complete quests for friendly NPCs 

Current player level cap: 250
Current weapon level cap: 50

Info:
VIP server have limitations on what can be earned in them. e.g. Soul Gems can only be earned from PvP in public servers
Exploiting will not be tolerated.  All bans are final

[Shift]: Sprint 
[C]: Quick Craft
[R]: Open Inventory 
[G]: Drop item 
[T]: Build Mode
[F]: Build Mode Snapping
[TAB]: Player list 
[Ctrl]: Lock camera
[M]: Map
